name: clinical-rag-eval-v1
notes: Questions were hand-written from the chunk text before any were run through retrieval, so the wording is not borrowed from the passages. LLM-generated questions reuse a chunk's own vocabulary and make the retriever look better than it is.
expected_chunks is a list because overlap places some content across two chunks; a hit on any of them is correct.
unanswerable questions are clinically plausible but genuinely absent from the corpus - they test refusal, not ignorance of obscure topics.

answerable.question: How long should a cough go on before someone sees a doctor?
answerable.rationale: 'Coughing persists for more than one week.'

answerable.question: Is there a prescription medicine that suppresses coughing?
answerable.rationale: Codeine listed as prescription cough suppressant.

answerable.question: Which nasal sprays bring down swelling inside the nose?
What does thick green discharge from the nose suggest?
answerable.rationale: Thick yellow or green mucus often indicates infection.

answerable.question: Which painkillers are suggested for head pain?
Which kind of sudden head pain needs urgent attention?
What signs mean breathing trouble has become an emergency?
answerable.rationale: Retractions; lips or fingernails turning blue or gray.

answerable.question: Are inhalers bought off the shelf a good idea?
Can this be handled with remedies from a pharmacy instead of a specialist?
answerable.rationale: No OTC medications or home remedies treat prostate cancer.

answerable.question: Why take care with decongestants when the prostate is involved?
answerable.rationale: Can tighten the prostate and trigger acute urinary retention.

answerable.question: Which exercises help regain bladder control after treatment?
Are there rub-on treatments for sore joints?
How does stiffness in the morning differ between the two joint conditions?
answerable.rationale: OA under 30 minutes; RA over 1 hour.

answerable.question: Does paracetamol bring down swelling as well as pain?
What drinks help soothe an irritated throat?
answerable.rationale: Water, herbal teas, broths (chunk 1); warm drinks (chunk 9).

unanswerable.question: What is the first-line treatment for malaria?
unanswerable.why: No infectious tropical disease content in the corpus.

unanswerable.question: What antibiotic dose should be given for pneumonia?
unanswerable.why: Antibiotics are mentioned for sinusitis, but no dosing anywhere.

unanswerable.question: How is type 2 diabetes managed long term?
unanswerable.why: No endocrine content beyond a single hypothyroidism heading.

unanswerable.question: What are the stages of chronic kidney disease?
Which vaccines are recommended before travelling abroad?
What is the normal reference range for serum potassium?
unanswerable.why: The only lab value in the corpus is a TSH result.
